 Russian army loses 1,980 troops, two air defense systems in Ukraine war over past day
 infographics 
 24.10.2026 08:23 
 Ukrinform 
 The total combat losses of Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to October 24, 2026, have reached approximately 1,576,600 personnel, including 1,980 killed or wounded over the past 24 hours. 
 According to Ukrinform, the General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces reported this on Facebook .
 The Russian army has also lost 12,444 (+5) tanks, 25,600 (+3) armored combat vehicles, 51,565 (+64) artillery systems, 2,232 (+2) multiple launch rocket systems, 1,722 (+2) air defense systems, 443 (+0) aircraft, 356 (+0) helicopters, 3,011 (+8) ground robotic systems, 579,064 (+1,855) operational-tactical UAVs, 5,138 (+0) cruise missiles, 35 (+0) ships and boats, 2 (+0) submarines, 166,501 (+413) vehicles and fuel trucks, and 4,852 (+1) units of special equipment.
 Read also: Ukrainian forces advance 15 km behind Russian lines through underground routes on Kupiansk front 
 The figures are being specified.
